analysis: Freeze contrasts before inference. Pair by source problem/template, never by output. Missing and capped outputs remain explicit. Original and strict scores stay separate. No receiver-specific fit on test data. Every source problem is crossed with last-distractor agreement/disagreement at each nonzero horizon, fixed by the final add modulo 10. Zero increments remain included and flagged; report their sensitivity separately. Model prefix samples differ, so family comparisons use matched oracle strata rather than unpaired aggregate accuracy. Explicit final digits with punctuation or a parenthetical annotation are scored separately from strict list formatting.
